notes.title: Dream Bar Simulator announcement!
notes.content:
We are proud to present you our new game Dream Bar simulator.

Welcome to the world of Dream Bar Simulator! 🍹
In this game you can imagine yourself as the owner of a successful bar. Create your dream bar with Dream Bar Simulator

What awaits you:
- Creative preparation process:a huge number of interesting cocktail recipes. 🍹✨
- Bar management: Take orders, manage your supplies, and grow your business! 💼
- Interesting customers 🥳
- Upgrades and rewards:transform your bar beyond recognition! 🏆
Gather your team, become a master of bartending, and create the bar of your dreams! Don’t miss the chance to dive into the thrilling world of Dream Bar Simulator! 🎮🌟
Coming soon to Steam!
Wishlist now!
